shortBio.en: The Police bassist/vocalist; later solo pop/jazz-leaning career after the trio ends.
shortBio.zh: The Police 贝斯/主唱；三人组结束后展开偏流行/爵士的独唱生涯。

whyHub.en: Band → solo split: Police catalog stays trio document; solo brand continues without Summers/Copeland.
whyHub.zh: 乐队→独唱分裂：Police 目录仍是三人组文献；独唱品牌不带 Summers/Copeland 继续。

body.en:
Born Gordon Sumner, 1951. Writes most Police melodies; melodic bass high in the mix. After 1986 builds a solo catalog. Reunion tours return to the trio silhouette.

Hub value: same voice, different logo economics.
body.zh:
本名 Gordon Sumner，1951 年生。写大部分 Police 旋律；旋律贝斯在混音高处。1986 后建独唱目录。重聚巡演回到三人剪影。

枢纽价值：同一把嗓，不同的 logo 经济。
